verdict.rationale: Relay's docs explicitly describe paying vendors via ACH and wire, with delivery estimates (1-3 days ACH, same-day wires), bill upload/approval workflows, and limit management, and community evidence confirms these payments work in practice (with the caveat that execution is manual, not autonomous). Pricing tiers also confirm faster ACH is available on Pro plan. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of wire payment success/reliability at scale, more detail on wire fees/limits.
